differs.layout: One account's chart fills a large card beside a quote column, instead of a seven-row table under a headline: the sparkline becomes the whole stage, with axis, bands and month labels.
differs.data: A single account's weekly score across a year, with two outcomes measured off it (points above its old level, weeks from playbook to healthy), instead of seven 30-day sparklines and a count of healthy rows.
differs.mechanic: Two brackets grow with the line: one under the climb from the playbook to the healthy crossing, one at the year's end rising from a dashed old-level line, and each outcome number beside the quote arrives when its bracket closes.
differs.moment: The line finishes above the dashed line marking where it was before the dip, the +9 bracket closes, and the quote's two numbers stand read off the chart.

blurb: A customer's year on one large health line: it dips into at risk, the playbook lands at the low point, and it recovers past where it was, with the two outcomes beside the quote read off the line.
